WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.product_name,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.product_name, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_product p ON p.sku = n.sku AND p.is_current
WHERE n.business_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)

FROM web_dispatch;
